title: MarketSignal
description: The ONLY shape the LLM extraction pipeline may write. Schema gate: anything not matching this is quarantined, never written. Confidence decays server-side (confidence * exp(-dt/tau)) before it becomes a model feature.

signal_type.description: Closed vocabulary — an open enum would let injected text define new signal types.

subject.description: SKU-level when identifiable; category-level for market-wide news (which has no single SKU).

polarity.description: Effect direction on our demand/price pressure.

magnitude.description: e.g. promo discount in percent; null when not quantifiable.

observed_at.description: When the fact was true in the world (from content), not when extracted.

confidence.description: Extractor-stated confidence. Schema IS the gate: anything below 0.7 is not a MarketSignal and can only enter quarantine (SignalQuarantined).

source_trust.description: Per-source reliability score maintained by MLOps; weights contradiction resolution.

trace_id.description: Correlates to the extraction span and, downstream, to decisions.

evidence_span.description: Verbatim quote from the source used as evidence (audit only).
